build_BoundaryAdjust_model: build a BoundaryAdjust model with temporal scale, base stride, and hidden dim options
run_forward_boundary_offsets: run forward pass on BoundaryAdjust to compute start and end boundary offsets from features
calculate_reg_loss: calculate regression loss for boundary adjustment using predicted offsets, anchors, and ground truth boxes
update_boundary_anchors: update anchor box boundaries by applying start and end offsets to refine temporal localization
